scope_deviations: Connect guest questionnaire to public landing/plans and existing authenticated profile. Share questionnaire fields, add bounded tab-only draft state and wire session/logout cleanup. Add real HTTP validation/security tests and browser tests; no SQL/schema or provider changes.

Share OnboardingChoices DTO without changing existing account validation or SQL. Browser uses default Chromium config; the card historical --project=chromium flag is not configured in this repository.
design: POST /api/onboarding/draft validates a strict non-sensitive DTO with existing strict single same-origin pre-auth CSRF protection. Draft is untrusted sessionStorage convenience, expires after 24h, binds to confirmed account namespace, never grants entitlement. Existing profile requires explicit use of draft, then explicit Save using server revision. Auth return paths stay /plans. No cross-tab/device draft promise.
